title_as_printed: Repeatability of CH4 and CO2 Solubility in CH4-CO2-H2O System

footnotes_as_printed: Solubility (mL/g): mL of gas (0 C, 101.3 kPa)/g of water.

pressure_note: equilibrium cell pressure (total); not stated whether water vapour is included

value.what: CO2 solubility in water; gas-volume per mass of water, not a mole fraction; empty where no CO2 in gas phase

value2.what: CH4 solubility in water, same definition

composition.other_species: pure water (liquid phase); no salt. The printed gas-phase CH4/CO2 mol % columns give the equilibrium gas phase (water not reported) and are not a liquid composition

extra_unmapped: Gas phase CH4 [mol%] and Gas phase CO2 [mol%] (equilibrium gas-phase composition, water-free basis, water not reported)
conversion_needs: Vg is the ideal-gas standard-state volume (0 C, 101.3 kPa) after real-gas correction by Z (Eq. 1, p.129); n = Vg/22414 mL/mol; mL gas per g water to molality needs a gas_volume_solubility converter (not applied)
notes: Titled as a repeatability table, but the values are measurements of mixed-gas solubility at 60 C by direct GC analysis of 1 microlitre samples of both phases. Each value is the mean of 3 repeats (CV given). Liquid-phase gas-phase compositions are measured, not set. Pressure column is not monotonic with gas composition because the series are different loadings.
